03 / DISSERTATION

Research thesis

THESIS / 2030

Explorations in Relativistic Spin Hydrodynamics

Sharad Shukla

An exploration of relativistic spin hydrodynamics and the theoretical framework describing spin degrees of freedom in relativistic fluids. The work examines questions at the intersection of relativistic fluid dynamics and spin physics.
